paragraphs: I'm a robotics and AI engineer who graduated from the University of Aleppo's Faculty of Informatics Engineering in 2025, specializing in Artificial Intelligence, with Honors (GPA 85.317/100).

Since June 2025 I've worked as a Robotics Engineer at SWB, where I build ROS 2 software for deployed robots and the applied-AI capabilities that run on them — object recognition and natural spoken interaction with people. Robotics is the part of the stack I taught myself after graduating, on top of the deep learning and NLP foundation from my degree.

My favourite problems sit at that intersection: training a model is one thing, getting it to run reliably on hardware with real constraints — weak actuators, a single sensor doing the job of several, a network link that isn't always there — is another. That's the kind of work behind my graduation project, a Coursera course-recommendation engine trained end to end on data I scraped myself, and my first ROS 2 project, two Lego EV3 robots mapping a space together over an MQTT bridge.
